items.title: Capitalism
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Time to get to work with these money-making and business-building animals!

- 10 unique skins
- by Zombeanie

items.title: Scan Me!
items.creator: Syclone Studios
items.description:
Baffle and amaze your friends with these brand new takes on what a Minecraft skin can be with Scan Me, the first ever QR code skin pack!

+ 10 fun and unique HD skins!
+ Enjoy being a QR code your friends will never solve!
+ Not quite scannable for added silliness.
+ From Syclone Studios

items.title: Chibis
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Have you been waiting for the perfect mix of cute and casual skins to hit the marketplace? Wait no more! With adorable chibi eyes and bright colors sure to grab anyone's attention, these skins are perfect for anyone who loves being adorable and charming. Equip these teens as you adventure in Minecraft and be the cutest with the Chibis skin pack. 

~Chibi fashionable teens

items.title: XRAY!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
What if you could look through stone and other objects to see where the ores and structures are? With the all new xray tool you can! Find diamonds, iron and other ores much easier without having to mine for hours. 
+ Make your survival adventure easier
+ Craftable xray tool that allows you to look through blocks
+ Make mining easier than ever before
+ Toggleable xray

items.title: Venetian Survival Roleplay
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Take over this huge Venice-inspired city! Use it as an amazing survival spawn and try to bring peace and order to a city full of mobs. Use it as the perfect setting for your roleplay adventures with friends. Craft custom entities anywhere in the entire world! Custom vehicles include an electric scooter, police car, sports car, sedan, truck and 4-seat gondola boat!

items.title: Aesthetic Cubes
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Check out these funky space cubes! Under their geometric shapes are galaxies, auroras and other cosmic colors! Stand out from the crowd wearing these colorful and unique Aesthetic Cubes!

- 10 skins
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Fashion Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play with your friends and roleplay with them a dream life. Want to be a fashion model, or a designer himself. Free yourself and start now.

+12 skins
+Famous
+Roleplay 

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Turbo Parkour Archery Trial
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
Can you beat the clock? Hop from block to block all across the sky and hit all your targets! Watch your step there's some tricky footing required to clear this parkour challenge! With a lot of skill and a little luck you can even earn an A rank!

- Includes a parkour course with archery challenges!
- Resets upon completion so you can try to best your last time!

items.title: Legendary Anime
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Throw your arms behind you and head into a full sprint in style with this colorful and trendy skin pack of the latest anime fashion. With a variety of shirts, blouses, vests, and jumpsuits, everyone will be calling you the senpai of style.

- Includes 8 HD skins
- Includes a wide selection of colors and options for all styles
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Sunflower Teens
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Do you love Nature? Then these skins are made especially for you! Choose between eight gorgeous colorful skins and enjoy these floral outfits with your friends!

- 8 Unique skins
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Fungi Awakening
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Fungi are everywhere; especially mushrooms! Come enjoy this variety of beautiful “mooshy” themed skins and blend in with Minecraft’s biomes! Trick your friends who will never suspect you were there!

12 unique and colorful mushroom-themed skins.
Perfect for hide-and-seek role-playing with friends.
By Varuna and Pathway Studios

items.title: Escape Room: Taiga Cabin
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Locked inside the Taiga Cabin, you must find your way out! Find clues, solve puzzles and escape in one hour. Race against the clock alone or with friends. Think you have what it takes?

- Multiplayer or singleplayer
- Challenging puzzles
- Real-life escape room feel

items.title: RGB Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs love RGB trends! Get the latest in rainbow fashion, and stand out from any crowd!

- 8 skins!

This set includes the following designs:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Slime
- Zombie
- Piglin
- Spider
- Pig
- Skeleton

items.title: Creeper Fashion
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Ready to explode your closet with new modern looks? This skin pack has 12 teen skins that are designed around everyone’s favourite mob, creepers! Whether you enjoy the colour green or just want to become the champion of mobs, these skins are for you. 

- 12 trendy skins
- Includes 1 free skin

items.title: Screen Heads HD
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
The time has come to get rid of your old modern clothes and update your style into something futuristic! Choose among the many TV heads for teens and rock the neon city with your bright new pixel art looks. From biomes to rainbows and everything in the middle, this pack has it all!

- 12 HD TV styles
- Includes 1 free skin

items.title: Summer Aesthetic
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Live your life in style this summer with these cool outfits!

+ 12 teen skins
+ Stylish summer outfits

items.title: Cyborg Teens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Be a sci-fi robot! Roleplay as a cyborg teen!

+ 10 teen cyborg skins!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Prison Escape
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Its time to escape prison! Gather resources in the prison mines to get tools to plan your break out. Do you have what it takes to make your prison escape?

+ Classic prison mine game with a twist!
+ Fight through prison brawls!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Bed Wars Skin Set!
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
This skin set is perfect for anyone who's a fan of 'Bed Wars' and wants everyone to know it! Dress up as a bed, camouflage yourself as wool blocks, or maybe obsidian is more your style!

- 12 skins!
- Multiple colors so you can pick the right one for whatever team you're on!

items.title: Parkour Rainbow Road
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Parkour Rainbow Road is a unique and vibrant parkour challenge! Do you have what it takes to get to the top? Race against your friends to see who will cross the finish line first!

- Great for all skill levels!
- Playable with friends!

items.title: Parkour Spheres
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Have a fun time jumping around in different spheres! They're made with different themes and beautiful scenery. Run, jump and complete all of the levels!

+ 8 different levels!
+ Beautiful fantasy scenery!

- By Orbital Studios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Orange Village
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
You find an abandoned royal village in the middle of the forest!
It looks like the king is gone, so what are you waiting for? 

+ A mysterious orange village, famous for its incredible castle!
+ Take over and rule the kingdom!

items.title: Anime Freaks
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Embrace your love for anime by sporting some of the most trendy outfits in town! Wear some of the most desired teen outfits and match with your friends. Let your passion for anime run wild!

+ 12 anime-themed skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Doge Studios.

items.title: Blue School Roleplay
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Skins based around the color blue! If you want to roleplay in a school, a city, or countless other blue-themed scenarios; this is the pack for you!

- 6 different blue teen skins included!
- Perfect for any type of themed roleplay!
- Licensed by Zander Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.
